name: Green Fireworks
label: Quest
description: Green Fireworks: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Progress
paras: When I finally get this booth up and running, I'll want to advertise! And what better way is there to advertise then with fireworks?
Well, some might think that the smell of a cauldron, churning with the boiling heads of your foes is better for drawing crowds, but... We're in mixed company. So fireworks it will have to be!
Bring me green fireworks, friend, and I have a big fistful of Darkmoon Faire tickets for you.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You brought the fireworks. Wonderful work, friend! I can't wait to light these and tell the world that my booth is ready to go! I must still wait, quite a long time I'm afraid, but... I'll be ready when I'm ready, yes?
Here are the tickets, friend. Enjoy yourself!
